intro: Fiji has two large volcanic islands, Viti Levu and Vanua Levu, and hundreds of small ones.

chapters.title: Islands and reefs
text: Mount Tomanivi on Viti Levu is the highest point. The Great Astrolabe Reef and Rainbow Reef are famous for diving. The Yasawa and Mamanuca islands have white beaches.

chapters.title: Cyclones
text: Cyclone Winston in 2016 was the strongest storm on record in the Southern Hemisphere.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Fiji's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
